name: FSLabs A321 (A321SL / A321neo)
notes: FSLabs runs its own FADEC and thrust-lever logic, so FlyRoll re-sends your recorded hardware throttle axis input (method 'axis') and keeps N1/N2 matched (spool 'assist'). Bind your throttle to the standard throttle axes and don't move it during replay. If you identify the thrust-lever LVars in Developer Mode > Tools > Behaviors, add them with the LVar tester and switch to 'lvar'. Flight controls are not replayed: the fly-by-wire computers treat a replayed stick input as a roll/pitch-rate demand and, with the aircraft held by the replay, drive ailerons and roll spoilers to full deflection on one side.
